questions.question: Russian ПИ + ВО forms ПИВО (“beer”). The English edition adapts the wordplay as PI + NT = PINT to preserve the drink punchline.

localizations.source: Russian ПИ + ВО forms ПИВО (“beer”). The English edition adapts the wordplay as PI + NT = PINT to preserve the drink punchline.
localizations.ru: В русском тексте ПИ + ВО образует ПИВО. Для английской версии использована адаптация PI + NT = PINT, сохраняющая шутку о напитке.

questions.resolution: The English edition uses PI + NT = PINT to preserve the drink punchline. The Russian edition keeps ПИ + ВО.
